detail.longDescription:
Thanks to everyone who came to our #AGNTCon + #MCPCon workshop, to @pamelafox@fosstodon.org for running it with me, and to the Agentic AI Foundation and @linuxfoundation@social.lfx.dev for having us.

The workshop repo is on GitHub. In six steps, you build an AI agent on local inference, trace it with #OpenTelemetry in Grafana, keep its history in Redis, give it tools over #MCP, and move the same containers to #Kubernetes. You don't need a GPU or a cloud account.

Try it: https://aka.ms/stack-it-yourself-workshop

#AIAgents #OpenSource
